content.text: {"scale_statement":"","scale_page":0,"cells":[{"key":"saas.mrr","page":1,"printed_figure":"$1,150,000","printed_label":"Monthly recurring revenue (MRR)","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"},{"key":"saas.arr","page":1,"printed_figure":"$13,800,000","printed_label":"Annual recurring revenue (ARR)","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"},{"key":"saas.net_new_arr","page":1,"printed_figure":"$401,940","printed_label":"Net new ARR in the month","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"},{"key":"saas.customers","page":1,"printed_figure":"210","printed_label":"Customers","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"},{"key":"saas.net_revenue_retention","page":1,"printed_figure":"117%","printed_label":"Net revenue retention, trailing 12 months","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"}],"comparative_cells":[],"absent_keys":[],"notes":["The document is a monthly MRR report only; it contains no income statement, balance sheet or cash flow statement for the ten months ended October 31, 2026, so only the SaaS metric lines were reported.","No prior-year comparative column is printed; the trailing six months table shows recent months only, so no comparative cells were reported.","The MRR bridge rows (opening MRR, new customers, expansion, contraction, churn, closing MRR) and the trailing six months table do not map to any template line and were not reported.","No units phrase is printed in the document."]}
